'''2007 Utah State Championship Matt Judd DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Judd]] at [[2007 Utah State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' AT-AT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
